nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Canonical environment-variable template (67 settings) covering app runtime, OpenTelemetry tracing, multi-provider LLM keys (GLM/OpenAI/Anthropic), embeddings, agent limits, workspace/tool approval, command sandbox, and Postgres/Mongo/Redis/Neo4j DSNs, plus JWT auth, multi-tenancy, rate limiting, uploads, and Hermes learning flags. Each variable maps 1:1 to a field on app/core/config.py:Settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Grouped .env style with section banners; mirrors a Pydantic Settings model field-for-field, so any rename here must be reflected in app/core/config.py.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project README (in Chinese) for the Self-Agent enterprise AI Agent. Covers features, tech stack (LangGraph + MCP + A2A + multi-protocol LLM), a 5-minute quick start (docker-compose infra, dependency install, env config, server launch, first chat), project structure, the three interaction modes (React web chat, local/remote CLI, direct API), documentation index, delivery progress, distributed tracing, upgrade guide, and known limitations.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown is primarily Simplified Chinese with bilingual technical terms; uses emoji section anchors and contains an explicit project-structure tree.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: PEP 621 build/dependency manifest for the self-agent Python (>=3.12) package. Declares the FastAPI/LangGraph/MCP/A2A stack with upper-bound version pins on every dependency for reproducible builds, optional-dependency extras, hatchling build backend targeting the app/ package, dependency-groups for dev tooling, and ruff + pytest configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PEP 621 [project] table with hatchling build backend; all dependencies carry explicit <next-major upper bounds (commented rationale) and rely on uv.lock for reproducibility.
